summary: Milestone 3 completes first-class Pages, internal tags with per-tag RSS, multi-author and featured curation, body-text search, and per-channel RSS on Cloudron beta.
detailed_changes: Added first-class Pages (separate table, staff CRUD, public /pages/{slug}) and Ghost type=page backfill with redirects from legacy /articles/{slug} URLs.
Added internal #tag visibility (hidden from public archives, nav, sitemap, and tag RSS) plus public per-tag RSS feeds.
Added multi-author pivot with primary author_id, featured post curation on home/channel, denormalized body_text search with documented ranking, and per-channel RSS at /{channel}/rss.xml.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public readers; feed subscribers; staff editors
Public impact: pages, deeper discovery, curated featured stories, channel and tag feeds
Internal impact: Ghost page import, co-authors, featured flag, body_text indexing on save
